answer_1.quote: The input of most tasks generally consists of a protein sequence paired with natural language text, while the output represents a functional description.
answer_1.outputs: functional descriptions, protein captions, answers to protein-related questions

answer_2.quote: To evaluate model performance on these benchmarks, researchers typically employ standard NLP metrics such as ROUGE, BLEU, and METEOR to measure the similarity between predicted answers and groundtruth references.

answer_3.quote: For LLM-as-a-Judge, we use the prompt in Appendix B. Note that when using LLM-as-a-Judge, bio-entities are extracted automatically by LLMs, so the high correlation between Entity-BLEU and LLM-as-a-Judge can illustrate the validity of our proposed bio-entity database.
